Scratch that, just fix it at utf8mb4 as long as it's a recent MySQL version

**Michael Bayer ([@zzzeek](https://github.com/zzzeek)) wrote:**

Use utf8mb4 (or utf8mb3) for all things MySQL

Fixed bug in MySQLdb dialect and variants such as PyMySQL where an
additional "unicode returns" check upon connection makes explicit use of
the "utf8" character set, which in MySQL 8.0 emits a warning that utf8mb4
should be used.  This is now replaced with a utf8mb4 equivalent.
Documentation is also updated for the MySQL dialect to specify utf8mb4 in
all examples.  Additional changes have been made to the test suite to use
utf8mb3 charsets and databases (there seem to be collation issues in some
edge cases with utf8mb4), and to support configuration default changes made
in MySQL 8.0 such as explicit_defaults_for_timestamp as well as new errors
raised for invalid MyISAM indexes.

Change-Id: Ib596ea7de4f69f976872a33bffa4c902d17dea25
Fixes: #4283
Fixes: #4192

issue.title: UTF8MB4 issue with MySQL 8
issue.body:
This doesn't happen with MySQL 5.x. Using latest SQLAlchemy (1.2.8) and PyMySQL (0.8.1) with Python 3.6.5, MySQL 8.0.11 on macOS 10.13.

```py
from sqlalchemy import create_engine

e = create_engine('mysql+pymysql://account@localhost:3306/db?charset=utf8mb4')
e.connect()

>>> ~/lib/python3.6/site-packages/pymysql/cursors.py:170: Warning: (3719, "'utf8' is currently an alias for the character set UTF8MB3, which will be replaced by UTF8MB4 in a future release. Please consider using UTF8MB4 in order to be unambiguous.")
  result = self._query(query)
```

This is [also reported to SQLAlchemy](https://bitbucket.org/zzzeek/sqlalchemy/issues/4283/utf8mb4-issue-with-mysql-8-and-pymysql). According to SQLAlchemy author (@zzzeek):

> SQLAlchemy passes this encoding right through to the driver so you should likely report this upstream to pymysql.

```py
from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import engine_from_config, pool

def run_migrations():
    url = "mysql+pymysql://society@localhost:3306/society?charset=utf8mb4"
    engine = engine_from_config(
        configuration={},
        url=url,
        poolclass=pool.NullPool
    )

    try:
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()
```

there is no occurrence of the "AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8" statement in SQLAlchemy 1.3.  please run alembic as follows:

    python -W"error:::pymysql.cursors" -m alembic.config  <alembic command>
